mgmt_bio.text: He joined Tokio Marine in 1994 as an assistant manager in ceded reinsurance in the non-marine underwriting department of Tokio Marine & Nichido Fire Insurance, and went on to head strategic initiatives in corporate planning, serve as general manager of corporate planning at Tokio Marine & Nichido, and oversee US operations as chief operating officer of Tokio Millennium Re AG, with experience spanning aerospace underwriting, ceded reinsurance and corporate strategy in Japan and the United States. He became Executive Officer and General Manager of the Corporate Planning Department of the holding company in April 2022, Managing Executive Officer in April 2023, and a director of Tokio Marine & Nichido in June 2025.
